title: A legendary set
body: Legendary pieces are rare and change how you play. Each set is built for one discipline, and its pieces drop from area bosses (and very rarely from elites in the Cloister, Pyre and Fen); your own discipline’s set is the most likely. Wear 2, 4 or 5 pieces of the same set: two is a nudge, four changes a mechanic, five defines the build. Hover a piece for exactly what each tier does. Wearing four or more gives your hero a faint glow in the set’s colour. The Codex lists all four sets and where they drop.

title: Spare gear for your legion

Its stats become thrall damage, health and attack speed, and each spare piece shows ▲ or ▼ against what the legion wears. title: A Relic rune

Open the Grimoire (L), choose a rite and socket the rune under the bar. One rune per rite, and it fits only its own. Take it out whenever you like; it is never lost. Runes stack in the Reliquary, can rest in the Vault and can be ground at the Bone Grinder. The Codex (K) lists them all.

The Gear Atlas (.) and the Codex (K) list each rune and where it drops.

title: Save a loadout

A loadout keeps your five rites, the rune in each rite and your weapon and off-hand together; Apply puts them all back at once. You can keep six, and in Settings (Esc) you can give Next loadout and Loadout 1-6 a key of your choice (they start unbound). A piece you have since sold or stored in the Vault is skipped and named, and nothing is ever lost from a full bag.

Click the glowing stair to go down; once you have been deeper than the first floor it asks whether to start at depth 1 or resume at your deepest floor. Slay a floor's quota and the stair beyond it opens; leaving or falling ends the run, and whatever you looted is yours. Your legion comes with you. Solo for now.
